title: Hatsune Miku — At Least Let Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I know what feelings the fragment originated from now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's definitely...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: ...! The feeling got stronger for a second just now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because I realized what kind of emotion it was...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please. Let me see more of what you're going through...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I felt it again! I think it's coming from over there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there's a wooden box buried in the ground. Could this be...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is it! It's a little weak but I sense so many feelings coming from here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But... Why is it coming from this box?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll just dig out enough soil to open the lid for now... Okay, here we go... Just a little more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What happened to the lid? It's covered in nails. There's also chains wrapped around it and a padlock...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The feelings in this wooden box... Was it necessary to go this far to shut them away?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... There're sheets of paper on the floor.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“Post-Graduation Plans”... “First Preference”...
There's nothing written underneath them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And this is...an answer sheet for a test.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this...a novel?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that's all that's on here. I guess the writer isn't finished...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Everything I found in this SEKAI... The novel, the manga and even the music sheets. They're all unfinished.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (On top of that, the unanswered form about post-graduation plans and the incomplete test answer sheet...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (All of these feelings from so many different people are shut in this box...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Actually, no...
They weren't shut away.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They were hidden...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it because they weren't wanted anymore? Or maybe, it got too overwhelming?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that why they were locked up and hidden...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born from...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The stress of choosing your own future, wasn't it...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unsure of whether what you're doing now is the right thing, or whether it's even enough...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No matter how hard you try, there're times when you're uncertain or afraid...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's so hard to find a place that makes you feel needed or welcomes you to try in a way that works best for you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It takes so much courage to chase after your dreams, and there are only so many people who can help you achieve them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And naturally... You get anxious, and lost... And impatient...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It must've been so hard for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So hard that you felt the need to lock those feelings up in this box and bury it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was it because you didn't want anyone to know? Was it because you couldn't tell anyone about it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Or... Was it so painful that you couldn't take it anymore and had to give up?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't understand. Why would you shut a lid on these feelings like this...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can only imagine just how unbearably difficult it must've been, but...it's such an important part of you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a part of who you are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All I want to do is to come find you, hold your hand and sing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And tell you that I'm here for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if you want to keep it a secret from others, even if you can't bring yourself to tell anyone, would you at least tell me...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: ...! This SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait! Please don't go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know you don't want to remember the pain and suffering, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even so, these feelings are a part of you...aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So please... Don't erase them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you don't want to remember, then you can forget them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But, at least let me hold on to them for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll be sure to keep every single fragment safe and sound.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come on now, join me...!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad I made it in time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for entrusting these feelings to me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It'll be okay. They'll all be right here.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Someday...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Some day, they will resonate with someone else's powerful emotions and become a part of a different SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And then, if a song is born from that SEKAI... I hope these fragments, even just a little bit, will be rewarded.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Until that time comes, I'll be right here beside you.
